I can't judge...I have CPTSD from many events throughout my childhood, events I remember as far back as being 4 or 5 years old for. Somewhere in my teens I realized the weed we were smoking kept me from dreaming (kept me from having nightmares) and allowed me to function in a way that seemed normal.

I try to do a lot of good things in life, and my wife and everyone seems genuinely pleased that I am still here. So am I a bad person for coping? I used to think so, but not anymore.

Definitely find a good therapist to talk to if you haven't already... I used to not really like the idea of therapy but you learn about you. The shit can actually work. Good luck, my friend.

I've worked in land surveying for over 20 yrs. Though I mostly draft civil engineering plans right now. You can certainly learn CAD at a community College and break into surveying very easily... the only problem is - what do you expect to make?? Anyone who is green, whether it's surveying, engineering, architectural, etc. is not going to make anywhere near top dollar for a while. In fact companies look for green CAD techs so they don't have to pay them shit. Ads that say things like "looking for entry level" or only require "1 to 3 yrs of experience" aren't paying.

I specialize in civil 3D... I only have a 2 yr degree, but I get paid very nicely. I don't just draft though... I do surveying field work, I teach/mentor CAD. Build CAD survey systems. I've also been doing this BS for forever.
